import json
R,C=26,22
g=[[8]*C for _ in range(R)]
# first panel: rows 2..10, cols 3..8, 3x3 motif
mot1=[[0,1,0],[1,0,1],[1,1,0]]
for r in range(2,11):
    for c in range(3,9): g[r][c]=mot1[(r-2)%3][(c-3)%3]
# second panel: rows 4..11, cols 13..18, 2x2 motif
mot2=[[4,0],[4,4]]
for r in range(4,12):
    for c in range(13,19): g[r][c]=mot2[(r-4)%2][(c-13)%2]
# third panel: rows 16..21, cols 3..10, 3x4 motif
mot3=[[3,0,3,3],[0,3,0,3],[3,3,0,3]]
for r in range(16,22):
    for c in range(3,11): g[r][c]=mot3[(r-16)%3][(c-3)%4]
print(json.dumps(g,separators=(',',':')))
